//: Pattern B - Claude Code managed settings pointing at the APIM AI gateway.
//base: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL must serve the Anthropic Messages API (POST /v1/messages). Point it at the APIM /anthropic route that fronts Foundry Claude.
//auth: Claude Code has no interactive Entra OAuth to a custom gateway. apiKeyHelper (07-apikeyhelper.sh) mints a per-user Entra token each refresh; Claude Code sends it in BOTH x-api-key AND Authorization: Bearer. The APIM policy validates Authorization, extracts oid, and strips both credential headers before the backend.
//pin: Pin a current, patched Claude Code build. Treat the CLI version as part of the contract and re-test on upgrade (a build change could alter header behavior).
//bypass: Deliver this via MDM/managed settings so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL cannot be pointed back at a public Anthropic endpoint. Enforcement and attribution only hold if the gateway is non-bypassable (Foundry private endpoint + MI-only RBAC + egress block).
//models: Set ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL to your Foundry Claude deployment names.

env.//helper-input: The apiKeyHelper reads these to request the correctly-scoped token. Use the /.default scope form to force a v2 token with the right audience (the gateway app, NOT ai.azure.com).

//alternative: No-gateway fallback (loses central attribution): Claude Code native Foundry mode - CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY=1 with ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE=<FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_NAME> and Entra via DefaultAzureCredential. Use only when a gateway is not available; attribution then falls back to the Pattern A diagnostic logs.
